name: WittyBluray
summary: Blu-ray images with their menus, including 4K, HDR and 3D discs.
updates: All of the engine: playlists and clips, running a disc's program and its Java programs, reading menus and subtitles.
stays: Drawing menus into pictures stays with the server, and so does refusing encrypted discs, on purpose. The session code that turns steps into streams stays too.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
Java, only for discs with Java menus, and only if you turn that on
